description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify Annual Liquor Licence Fees under Excise Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends the Excise Ordinance by specifying new annual liquor license fees and security deposit requirements. It exercises powers under existing legislation (Excise Ordinance Chapter 52) and rescinds previous notifications, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on establishing legal requirements and compliance frameworks for liquor licensing.
